epics.title: Measurement: Code Delivery Integrity
epics.jtbd: When stakeholders rely on reported progress, I want to measure whether tasks marked as done actually exist on the main branch, so that we can trust the delivery pipeline metrics.
requirements: R1: Are tasks marked as done actually merged to main?
R2: What is the rate of missing deliverables per sprint?
R3: Implement a metric tracking the ratio of done tasks to verifiable merged PRs.

slices.title: Implement delivery integrity metrics
slices.jtbd: When implementing this epic, I want to add instrumentation tracking task-to-PR merge ratio, so that stakeholders can verify delivery integrity.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task marked as done,
When the metrics are evaluated,
Then it correctly checks for an associated merged PR.
Given the delivery metrics,
When queried over a sprint,
Then it accurately reports the rate of missing deliverables.

slices.title: Verify delivery integrity metrics
slices.jtbd: When verifying this epic, I want to ensure the delivery integrity metrics are tested, so that they report accurately.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the delivery metrics implementation,
When the test suite runs,
Then the metric calculations are verified for edge cases including tasks with and without PRs.
